reported_context.athlete_request: Maximum outdoor dose today; athlete would prefer two to three hours or 20 km at a slower pace with breaks.

fresh_evidence.hrv: 47 ms and BALANCED, balanced-low boundary 46 ms
fresh_evidence.cns: ready 84.6 with normal ceiling if physical readiness allows
fresh_evidence.load_focus: Low aerobic 271.5 within range 261-662; high aerobic 1120.9 above maximum 873; anaerobic 410.9 just above maximum 400.
fresh_evidence.recent_density: Yesterday MTB 97.5 minutes/load 182.1 with 22.8 minutes in HR Z4+Z5; rolling seven days 442.7 minutes/load 656.7 and three MTB sessions.
fresh_evidence.coverage_caveat: Morning low stress 17 cannot earn positive readiness credit because coverage ends at 10:02 and contains 36 minutes of material internal unavailability.

coach_decision_framework.kiara_or_technical_mtb: Use the existing 60-minute target and 70-minute absolute cap with no more than two familiar 2K descents.
coach_decision_framework.flat_nontechnical_outdoor: A separate ceiling of 90 minutes moving and 120 minutes elapsed, up to 20 km, is conditionally defensible only if the ride stays genuinely Z1/Z2, RPE no higher than 3 and load no higher than 80.
coach_decision_framework.reason: Fresh recovery supports riding, but high-aerobic and anaerobic load are already saturated and yesterday's MTB neural/high-intensity cost remains active. Breaks do not erase cumulative climbing, heat or technical exposure.

lap_notes.lap_1: Slow climb with a mid-climb detour to inspect another trail.
lap_notes.lap_2: Fork HSC +1, chill pace; rider reported the firmer setting felt harsher at the slower pace and the front deflected on roots mid-corner.
lap_notes.lap_4: Fork HSC -1, chill pace; rider reported more mid-turn braking and less ability to commit fully to the exit.
lap_notes.lap_6: Approximately half of 2K after returning to HSC +1. The clean confirmation led the rider to classify the lap-2 deflection as rider error rather than an HSC +1 setup failure.

setup_changes.fork_hsc_sequence: HSC +1 on lap 2, HSC -1 on lap 4, HSC +1 on lap 6

reported_context.late_session_focus: Focus reduced during lap 6 and was not as sharp as the previous day. Athlete suspects the chill intent reduced attentional intensity; lap 4 required more deliberate mental focus.
reported_context.egress: Chill egress after the final technical test.
reported_context.adherence_reflection: Athlete stated that two descents would have been best as prescribed, but added the partial third descent to avoid second-guessing whether HSC +1 suited slower riding.

fueling_totals.basis: One litre 100Plus Active plus one 15 g honey sachet using the athlete-supplied product values already preserved in coaching memory.

session_contract_review.correct_exit_recognition: Lap 4 required more mid-turn braking and reduced exit commitment; no exit miss was reported.
session_contract_review.front_tracking_and_intended_steering: Front deflected on roots mid-corner during lap 2. A clean HSC +1 partial lap 6 led the athlete to classify the earlier deflection as rider error rather than setup failure.
session_contract_review.front_ping_pack_down_or_deflection: One front deflection on lap 2; no repeated HSC +1 deflection on lap 6. Ping and pack-down were not reported.
session_contract_review.vision_and_decision_speed_first_vs_final: Opening gate was good; focus and sharpness were reduced by lap 6 versus the prior day.
session_contract_review.athlete_stop_wording: Stop triggered in lap 6 when focus was reducing; technical work stopped and only chill egress followed.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: HSC +1 supported greater exit commitment than HSC -1 at chill pace. Lap 2 included a mid-corner root deflection later classified by the rider as rider error after a clean HSC +1 partial lap 6. Focus reduced during lap 6 and triggered the stop.
